style: Planetary ground and rock surfaces for volcanic, icy, desert, lunar and earth-like worlds.

cells.name: basalt
cells.prompt: Dark grey vesicular basalt lava rock with many small gas holes, cracks and rough grit.

cells.name: snow-crust
cells.prompt: Wind-crusted snow surface seen from above: wavy sastrugi ridges, icy crust and soft blue shadows.

cells.name: glacial-ice
cells.prompt: Clear blue glacial ice with white fracture lines, trapped bubbles and frost.

cells.name: sandstone
cells.prompt: Layered beige sandstone with fine wavy horizontal strata and small erosion pits.

cells.name: ripple-sand
cells.prompt: Pale fine sand seen from above with regular wind ripples.

cells.name: regolith
cells.prompt: Grey lunar regolith: fine dust with scattered pebbles, small rocks and tiny craters.

cells.name: moss-granite
cells.prompt: Speckled grey granite with patches of green moss and lichen.

cells.name: wet-mud
cells.prompt: Dark brown wet mud with puddle sheen, footprints-free, small stones and cracks.

cells.name: gravel
cells.prompt: Loose grey mixed gravel of small angular and rounded stones seen from above.
